shared_elements: upright monolithic slab whose form implies a body with a distinct head/top zone above a broad torso-like shaft
low-relief motifs carved on the flat frontal face
horizontal band-like division across the shaft
justification: Both surfaces are frontal faces of tall upright slabs that read as abstracted bodies, with a distinct upper head/cap zone above a broad torso bearing shallow low-relief motifs, including at least one elongated sinuous form and a transverse band across the shaft. The decisive difference in content is that A's relief shows recognisable animals in profile (a quadruped above a snake-like creature) with no anthropomorphic features, whereas B depicts an explicit humanoid figure with facial area, encircling arms, a belt and a central disc on the abdomen; there is no shared specific motif beyond generic upright-slab-with-relief conventions.
